Name: Totto's Lazy Pet Capybara
Author: totusthegreat
Description:
To use this mod you must have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed.
Download the mod and extract it into your Mods folder - done!

If you want you can change the look of your Capy in the config.json file, just replace the default color to the color of your choosing!

Downloads.Description: Added new colors and fixed the dog bug! <3

Manifest.Name: Lazy Pet Capybara
Manifest.Description: Changes the Pet into a lazy Capybara
Manifest.Author: Totto
